input.quote: 13.4 Limitation of Liability. Notwithstanding any provision in this Agreement, M&I's total liability under this Agreement shall not exceed payments made to M&I by Customer under this Agreement during the three (3) months prior to the event.
input.rationale: Section 13.4 caps only M&I's liability (Customer is left uncapped) and sets the cap at three months' payments, which is below the six-month walk-away floor and fails the fallback requirement of a mutual 12-month fees cap. No carve-out exists anywhere for indemnification (Section 14.2), confidentiality (Section 17), gross negligence or willful misconduct, so indemnities sit inside the cap with no super-cap. Section 13.2 already excludes indirect and consequential damages mutually. We therefore edited the existing cap sentence to be mutual and based on twelve months' fees and added one carve-out sentence, targeting the fallback position; preferred items (USD 1,000,000 floor, fraud, IP infringement, payment-obligation exclusion) are noted but not pursued at this level.

mappings.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
The cap is based on 12 months of fees.
Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.

proposal.summary: Make the Section 13.4 cap mutual and based on 12 months' fees, and add carve-outs for indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and willful misconduct.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We made the Section 13.4 cap mutual and aligned it to twelve months' fees rather than a three-month, M&I-only limit, and we placed indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and willful misconduct outside the cap. This is our fallback position on limitation of liability.

ops.oldText: M&I's total liability under this Agreement shall not exceed payments made to M&I by Customer under this Agreement during the three (3) months prior to the event.
ops.newText: each party's total liability under this Agreement shall not exceed the fees paid or payable to M&I by Customer under this Agreement during the twelve (12) months prior to the event.

ops.text: The limitation of liability in the first sentence of this Section 13.4 shall not apply to a party's indemnification obligations under Section 14.2, breach of its confidentiality obligations under Section 17, gross negligence, or willful misconduct.
